■ Thousands of communities

Product reviewers, music critics, sports fans, or doge enthusiasts—find people that obsess and care about whatever it is you’re interested in.
■ Anonymous profiles so you can do you
On Reddit, you (not your job, number of friends, or social status) define who you are.

POLITICAL BIAS
For US news, DeepNews shows the political bias of the topic.

NEWS UPDATES
DeepNews keeps you informed about important, ongoing news that matters to you.

TRENDS
The trends show you which people (politicians, athletes, actors, ...) are currently attracting how much attention in the press.

SPORTS
In Sports, DeepNews shows live scores, standings, win probabilities and league predictions for the main European soccer leagues (other sports will follow soon).

SEARCH
In Search you can search for specific topics. The results contain news only — and no ads.

SAVE AND HISTORY
Here you can manage all bookmarks and history, i.e. which articles you have read so far.

PROFILE
In profile you can find all information about your account and us. Here you can configure DeepNews according to your interests.
